newsitem.title: USA: Rexall sees shorts fueling stock trading.
newsitem.headline: Rexall sees shorts fueling stock trading.

text.p: Rexall Sundown Inc president and chief executive officer Chris Nast said Monday the company's recent unusual stock trading may be due to an exceptionally large short position in the stock.
In a statement, Nast also said that "rumors of a negatively slanted article that appeared in today's Barron's has fueled recent weakness in the stock price," of Rexall.

He noted that, while the vitamin and nutritional supplements maker does not normally respond to stock performance, the company feels it is important to reaffirm to the company's strong business fundamentals and future prospects.

"As one of the leaders in the growing dietary supplement category, Rexall Sundown remains well positioned to capitalize on this trend," he said. He said that, in addition to expanding its core business, the company plans to grow further by using its financial resources to make acquisitions of complimentary products or businesses.
